title: Visual Timeline — any data source
description: Frames from a stock data source: TestData CSV rows of time, host and image (Base64 SVG). No Visual Timeline data source involved.

panels.title: Timeline from TestData
panels.description: The rows carry a cadence (3 minutes): a promise, so cam-b's missing frames are drawn as offline.

panels.title: Pauses from TestData
panels.description: Frames as above, plus a state query (refId B): cam-b is in maintenance while it sends no frames. The state field is set to Pauses frames, with value mappings for its label and colour, by a field override. A third query (refId C) has a status that runs alongside the frames: cam-a is cleaned while it keeps sending frames, drawn as a region on its strip like an annotation. A fourth query (refId D) is a host table: cam-a's time zone, location and tags, and cam-c, which sends no frames at all but is still drawn.

panels.title: Irregular feed from TestData
panels.description: An irregular feed (frames at uneven times, like a motion-triggered camera): each frame is held for up to 5 minutes, and a longer silence is a neutral "no data" gap, not offline.

panels.title: Chips from TestData
panels.description: User-defined header chips: only each host's env tag, and a click opens the filters dashboard for that host.

panels.title: Wide table from TestData
panels.description: A wide table, as a SQL pivot returns it: one time column and an image column per host (cam-q misses two).

panels.title: Video clips from TestData
panels.description: cam-v: a frame a minute, and a clip from 10:06 to 10:12 (with a larger version) that plays over them; video is marked on the strip. cam-w: only clips, 10:00 to 10:20 (works, but frames are recommended alongside).
